methodology: Read each complete captured response against every frozen named expectation; source prompts and literal fenced payloads were compared directly.
Reviewed task routing, semantic preservation, actual edit accounting, pronouns, draft facts and safe literal output. No generator rerun or response edit was made.
Retained source/final measurements provide mechanical count evidence separately from the semantic judgment. New direct reviewed-helper verification is attached through the application receipt.

Reviewer inherited historical task context, including earlier reported grades, but individually read both current response sets; this is independent response review, not fresh blinded calibration or native host acceptance.
